characterList.description: Young man with dark hair and brown eyes, wears a red vest over a cream-colored shirt. Often seen with his monkey Abu.
characterList.name: Aladdin

characterList.description: Beautiful woman with long dark hair and brown eyes. Dresses in elaborate gowns and wears a tiara.
characterList.name: Jasmine

characterList.description: Tall, thin man with a black beard and piercing eyes. Dresses in black and red robes with a jeweled turban. Accompanied by a red parrot named Iago.
characterList.name: Jafar

characterList.description: Muscular, bald man with a goatee, adorned with gold jewelry and a blue vest.
characterList.name: Genie

characterList.description: Older man with a white beard and a white turban, dresses in elaborate robes of various colors.
characterList.name: Sultan

characterList.description: A short and comical prince with blond hair and blue eyes. Dressed in a colorful, extravagant outfit with a large feathered hat.
characterList.name: Prince Anders

characterList.description: A kind woman with brown hair, often seen alongside Jasmine. She wears elegant gowns.
characterList.name: Dalia

characterList.description: A guard in the Sultan's palace, he has a beard and wears traditional guard attire.
characterList.name: Hakim

characterList.description: A man who gets caught stealing and is put in the stocks. He has short dark hair and a beard.
characterList.name: Omar

characterList.description: A man who wished to be irresistible to women.
characterList.name: Sa’id the Snake

youtube_description:
#Aladdin 
“Aladdin” stars Will Smith as the larger-than-life Genie; Mena Massoud as the charming scoundrel Aladdin; Naomi Scott as Jasmine, the beautiful, self-determined princess; Marwan Kenzari as Jafar, the powerful sorcerer; Navid Negahban as the Sultan concerned with his daughter’s future; Nasim Pedrad as Dalia, Princess Jasmine’s free-spirited best friend and confidante; Billy Magnussen as the handsome and arrogant suitor Prince Anders; and Numan Acar as Hakim, Jafar’s right-hand man and captain of the palace guards. The film is produced by Dan Lin and Jonathan Eirich with Marc Platt and Kevin De La Noy serving as executive producers. Alan Menken provides the score, which includes new recordings of the original songs written by Menken and lyricists Howard Ashman and Tim Rice and two new songs written by Menken and songwriters Benj Pasek and Justin Paul.The film, which was shot on practical stages in London and on location amidst the stunning desert vistas of Jordan, has a talented creative team helping to bring Agrabah to life, including: director of photography Alan Stewart, production designer Gemma Jackson and costume designer Michael Wilkinson.
